notes.title: Full Release!
notes.notes:
Hex of the Lich is released!  Whoo!

Check out the last post for more info on what's new.

Here are just a few more things that I slipped into the full release:

Left-click creatures to lock focus so it's easier to inspect them
Fullscreen/windowed toggle in settings
Enable/disable victory animation toggle in settings
Multi-hex rewards
New enemies
Even MORE new hexes
Performance improvements with drawing hexes
Fixed all known bugs

I'm excited to see what you think!  Be sure to leave a review or drop a message on Steam or Discord if you have any questions.

Cheers,
Zac

notes.title: The "Demodaemon" Update
notes.notes:
Hex of the Lich is still in development, but it's getting close to release.  There are 3 floors of content developed, with loads of new high-level enemies and god-tier spells to blast them away!  This will likely be the last demo update before release.

Major Changes:
- View future stages and select your path with a new world map!
- Collect powerful artifacts that enhance your character(!) in shops.
- Hexes and spells are free after each combat.  Shops contain hexes and artifacts.
- View your past victories and defeats!
- New run stats including time taken and "slain by".
- New spells and hexes!  MANY more added to the full version.
- New enemies summoned by the Lich.
- Tutorial now plays on your first run.
- The game saves after each combat and shop.
- Change game speed and other things in the settings.  Settings now persist when the game is closed.

Other changes:
- Hexes trigger in a more intuitive order
- New first floor boss added
- Various balance changes
- Difficulty decreased slightly
- Credits updated
- All known bugs fixed

Cheers!
-Zac

notes.title: The "Pretty Big" Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816353/1c2fe0118568a4863710e56fb4627c9260517890.png

Hi!  Hex of the Lich is still in heavy development, but I thought I'd post an update on the progress so far.

The biggest change with this update is the switch from 3 characters to 1.  Players often found 3 characters overwhelming, and the amount of spells and abilities each could have made for some dizzying combinations.  Although that could be fun, it added a lot of complexity to the game- complexity which could be better used on the crazy spell system.

Which brings us to the second BIG change- hexes can have multiple effects!  You can stack up to 3 effects on each hex, combining them to do some pretty wacky stuff!  Summon a minion and Empower it the same turn, create a rock and then fire chain lightning off it, or apply frail to an enemy before blowing it up with TNT!

Other changes:
- Preview hex damage/effects without having to hover over them
- Replaced the "upgrade cost" system for a "number of upgrades" system
- Replaced the "recharge rate" system with a "number of charges" system
- Levels are now procedurally generated
- Enemies now have 1-2 abilities instead of 3
- Some statuses/effects tweaked
- Removed squad/difficulty select for new (it'll be back later)
- Press tab to cheat :)

There are lots of new spells, enemies, music, and quality of life changes as well.  The tutorial was scrapped for now, but it'll be back soon.

Cheers!
-Zac
